items.title: Australians face record high rents as agents see 'inquiries flooding in'
items.description: Rents are soaring in several capital cities as low vacancy rates collide with rising interest rates and population growth.

items.title: ABC rejects claims of antisemitic bias ahead of fronting royal commission
items.description: The ABC and SBS will face questioning over complaints of bias and antisemitism when executives appear at the royal commission on Thursday.

items.title: 'Twenty minutes or so': The blunt warning of China's nuclear capability
items.description: Victor Gao, the vice-president of a major Chinese think tank, conducts some sabre-rattling in the wake of China's missile test in the Pacific.

items.title: Native title holders celebrate return of 'special country' in access win
items.description: Traditional owners from the Utopia region north of Alice Springs celebrate the recognition of their native title over an area encompassing more than 4,000 square kilometres.

items.title: Delay in Telstra alerting communications minister to outage revealed
items.description: Telstra has defended its communication process, insisting the government and other stakeholders were informed "very, very early" in the morning.

items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire 'over' after latest strikes
items.description: Donald Trump says the ceasefire with Iran is over, warning that the US would likely engage in additional strikes, following fresh attacks across the Gulf.

items.title: Cleary 'silences the critics' as NSW make Origin history with decider win
items.description: NSW has produced a historic performance to win the State of Origin series with a win over Queensland at Lang Park in Brisbane.

items.title: More than 120 NSW crown prosecutors take rare step over DPP report
items.description: Senior crown prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC issued the extraordinary statement on behalf of the more than 120 barristers who take on cases for the crown.

items.title: World Cup quarterfinals are upon us. Here's what you need to know
items.description: The World Cup has whittled 48 teams down to just eight, with the quarterfinals upon us and the finish line in sight. Find out all you need to know about these monumental matches.

items.title: Calling all budding storytellers living with disability
items.description: If you are an emerging content maker or journalist with disability and have a story to tell, now is your chance to work with the ABC to tell it.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
